# loko

> A compiler for software architecture. loko compiles a C4 model architecture from HCL (`*.loko.hcl`) and projects it into D2 and SVG diagrams, markdown, a static site, graph queries, a JSON or TOON export, and an MCP server that lets assistants describe, query, validate and edit the HCL.

The HCL is the only authored artefact. Every reference is resolved at compile time, so a broken relationship is an error with a file, line and column. Output is byte-stable. Diagrams render in-process; no `d2` binary is needed.

## Core documentation

- [README](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/README.md): Overview, installation and a first architecture
- [Quick start](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): From an empty directory to a rendered, queryable architecture
- [Language reference](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/docs/language.md): Every block, attribute and function, with a complete example
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md): validate, fmt, build, serve, query, export, mcp
- [MCP integration](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/docs/mcp-integration.md): The five MCP tools (describe, query, validate, apply_edit, move) and client setup
- [Configuration](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): Where settings live (there is no configuration file)

## LLM knowledge base

- [C4 model](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/docs/llm/c4-model.md): C4 levels and how each maps to loko HCL
- [Patterns](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/docs/llm/patterns.md): Common architectures written in HCL

## Guides

- [CI/CD integration](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/docs/guides/ci-cd-integration.md): validate --strict, fmt --check and build in pipelines
- [Site theming](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/docs/guides/site-theming.md): Overriding the generated site's templates and styles
- [TOON format](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/docs/guides/toon-format-guide.md): The compact encoding used by MCP, query and export

## Examples

- [Examples](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/tree/main/examples): Complete HCL example projects
- [Serverless reference](https://github.com/madstone-tech/loko/blob/main/testdata/projects/serverless-reference/main.loko.hcl): A realistic serverless AWS system using titles, shapes, relationship kinds and Terraform bindings

## Container image

Published to `ghcr.io/madstone-tech/loko` (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, distroless, entrypoint `loko`, working directory `/workspace`) on every tagged release.
